content: Why have people screw the fan in BEFORE putting it here its so much easier  to do this without the fan in place!
Remove the fan before installing. Otherwise its near to impossible to get the second screw tightened. Also you probably want to loosen the belts first.

replies.content: The ball end hex key included with the Prusa tools works just fine with the fan installed. You don't need to remove the fan.
